From 4d10edfd1475b69dbd4c47f34b61a3772ece83ca Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Kuniyuki Iwashima <kuniyu@google.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Jan 2026 18:54:44 +0000
Subject: [PATCH] l2tp: Fix memleak in l2tp_udp_encap_recv().

syzbot reported memleak of struct l2tp_session, l2tp_tunnel,
sock, etc. [0]

The cited commit moved down the validation of the protocol
version in l2tp_udp_encap_recv().

The new place requires an extra error handling to avoid the
memleak.

Let's call l2tp_session_put() there.

Fixes: 364798056f518 ("l2tp: Support different protocol versions with same IP/port quadruple")
Reported-by: syzbot+2c42ea4485b29beb0643@syzkaller.appspotmail.com
Closes: https://lore.kernel.org/netdev/696693f2.a70a0220.245e30.0001.GAE@google.com/

diff --git a/net/l2tp/l2tp_core.c b/net/l2tp/l2tp_core.c
index 687c1366a4d0..70335667ef03 100644
--- a/net/l2tp/l2tp_core.c
+++ b/net/l2tp/l2tp_core.c
@@ -1086,8 +1086,10 @@ int l2tp_udp_encap_recv(struct sock *sk, struct sk_buff *skb)
 	tunnel = session->tunnel;
 
 	/* Check protocol version */
-	if (version != tunnel->version)
+	if (version != tunnel->version) {
+		l2tp_session_put(session);
 		goto invalid;
+	}
 
 	if (version == L2TP_HDR_VER_3 &&
 	    l2tp_v3_ensure_opt_in_linear(session, skb, &ptr, &optr)) {
-- 
2.34.1

## Summary of Modifications

### File: `net/l2tp/l2tp_core.c`

- **Change**: Added a call to `l2tp_session_put(session)` before the `goto invalid` in the protocol version mismatch check.
- **Context**: Inside `l2tp_udp_encap_recv()`, after retrieving the `session` and `tunnel`, the function validates that the packet’s protocol version matches the tunnel’s version. If they differ, the code now releases the reference to the session (via `l2tp_session_put()`) before jumping to the `invalid` label, which handles packet dropping.

### Relationship Between Modifications

This is a single-file change that fixes a memory leak. The leak occurred because the prior commit introduced a new validation point (protocol version check) in `l2tp_udp_encap_recv()`, but forgot to drop the session reference held at that point when the check fails. Without the added `l2tp_session_put()`, the session (and subsequently the tunnel and socket) could never be freed, leading to a memory leak. The fix ensures proper reference counting is maintained along all error paths in the function.
